body.name: resTok
body.def: A token \(r=(\tau,K,\mathcal J,\Pi,\mathcal P,\mathcal C)\) stores either the unique graphically residual-ready task or the marker that all tasks are complete, its labelled kernels and constraints, the accumulated projection circuit \(\Pi\), the fixed finite projection list \(\mathcal P\), and the fixed finite list \(\mathcal C\) of tensor products of signed canonical response-row swaps. In the completed case \(\Pi\) is the first projection candidate.
